notes.title: Sign up for our Gamescom Playtest!
notes.content:
[p]Hello![/p][p]We’ve got exciting news: [i]Nice to Yeet You[/i] is heading to Gamescom this year, and we want YOU to be part of the chaos before the big event. Starting today, you can sign up for our exclusive Gamescom Playtest and get an early sneak peek at the latest build of our fast, chaotic, and slightly unhinged 2D brawler.[/p][p]This is your chance to test new features, try out fresh arenas, wear some nice hats and help us fine-tune the ultimate yeeting experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118042/5aa3abc99f9101af3787233607380cf2a11af3c0.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Playtest Dates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Playtest opens: 18th August
[/p][/*][*][p]Playtest closes: 25th August[/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Join:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Click on the green [b]"Request Access"[/b] button on the [i]Nice to Yeet You[/i] Steam page.
[/p][/*][*][p]Smash it. (Gently. No actual yeeting of your mouse.)
[/p][/*][*][p]Keep an eye on your inbox — we’ll be sending invites soon.[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118042/783f06b8413fb7a336abc809192e88e090699625.gif"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your feedback, watch your highlight clips, and see just how far you can fling your opponents. Let’s make Gamescom a blast — literally.[/p][p]Ready? Aim. YEET[b].[/b][/p][p]Remember to join our [url="https://t.co/S6MHqQ5bYy"]Discord[/url] to stay in the loop and of course, Wishlist and Follow for all the latest news![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Nice to Yeet You!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We thought it was about time we introduced ourselves and our game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118042/85ae6f1426cfa7352127a4d8ce3871f5790f3564.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re Empty Bottle, a Sardinian-based solo independent studio and our first game Nice to Yeet You is coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]We’re working with The CoLab to bring you Nice to Yeet You, a one-on-one party brawler that pairs precision-based combat with a striking, minimalist style![/p][p][/p][p]Bounce against your opponents, throw them against the wall and make the box rotate. Freeze to defend from dangerous attacks and find all the endless opportunities to [b]yeet[/b] your enemies into oblivion in this brawler you don't want to miss![/p][p][/p][p]Built on a simple two-button control scheme, Nice to Yeet You delivers fast, chaotic matches that are easy to pick up and difficult to walk away from. Whether using a controller or mouse and keyboard, you will be thrown into short rounds where timing, movement and a well-placed yeet make all the difference![/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://t.co/S6MHqQ5bYy"]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with all things Yeet![/p]
